description:
Validate vault files against the schemas. Also reports files that are not valid UTF-8.

Usage: lint [--schemas DIR] [--quiet] [PATH ...]

Args:
  PATH  files to validate; zero or more. Default: walk the whole vault.

Flags:
  --schemas DIR  schemas directory. Default: the schemas bundled with the tools.
  --quiet  suppress per-violation output; only the exit code is reported.

Examples:
  []
  ["notes/2026-09-10-14-30-00.md"]
  ["--quiet"]

Notes:
  Each violation prints as <absolute path>:<line>: <message>.
  Exit 0: clean. Exit 1: one or more violations. Exit 2: no schemas could be loaded.
